newsitem.title: FRANCE: CGIP H1 profit jumps on exceptional gain.
newsitem.headline: CGIP H1 profit jumps on exceptional gain.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
NOTE - Holding company Cie Gnrale d'Industrie et de Participations issued half-year results in a statement.

It said it booked an exceptional 309 million franc gain in the first half of 1996: a profit generated in 1991 when Debis took a stake in Sogeti and deferred until the merger of Cap Gemini with Skip and Sogeti.

It said its holdings in Wheelabrator Allevard, Orange-Nassau, Crown Cork & Seal, Cap Gemini and BioMerieux Alliance showed an overall 15 percent rise in pre-tax, pre-exceptional profit, with holdings in all but the packaging business contributing gains.
"The second half of 1996 should confirm this trend," CGIP said.
